notes.title: Best Elf Development Ramping Up!
notes.notes:
That's right, bakas! We are shifting gears from Girls Overboard and pushing full steam into Eleanna's butt! Well, technically not full-full steam, but we're going REALLY hard! -Wait, that came out weird. Let me clarify..

Between Girls Overboard updates I have been doing pre-production work, Best Elf (planning/ writing/ artwork), and I'm happy to say, the time has come to start full production! Or in non-fancy terms, my programmer teammate has started working on Best Elf as well. This means development is going to start moving much faster!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240
Best Elf will be a traditional style visual novel, focusing on Eleanna the Archery Instructor and Zariinna the Rogue. BE will feature adult content, multiple routes, and endings that are determined by your choices. Best Elf will take place after the true good ending of Faulty Apprentice, and continue the story as a whole, but will not require playing the base game to enjoy. However, we do recommend playing Faulty Apprentice beforehand in order to get the most out of the Best Elf story experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485931/833204051738ade6060cf9bfaa7567bc260af005.jpg[/img]

So, if you haven't played our flagship game, Faulty Apprentice yet, now is a great time! Aside from the major endings, there are a lot of variations to the Final Battle's course, from the equipment you wear, to the morale of each character (including guards), so if you've already played it once, its a great time to replay! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/630550
If you are interested in a (spoiler free) early-access look at Best Elf or just want to show your support, I invite you to join the Faulty Apprentice patreon [ [url=https://www.patreon.com/FaultyApprentice]here[/url] ]

I hope you look forward to playing Best Elf! 
-Din

notes.title: 💚 New Visual Novel Announced 💜
notes.notes:
[quote=author]Since the battle, Stars Reach Castle has been peaceful and light. However, for a certain two elves, things haven't been going quite right... Is it the result of a contest with tunics most wet, or perhaps two personalities that conflict and don't set, a feud has erupted between two elves that just met.
From training proclivity to fun time activity, no matter the task, no matter the reason, these girls have not limit, well except maybe treason. Has Eleanna's want to be the best gone from desire to obsessed? Or have Zariinna's reprisals gone from taunts to torments? This rivalry is sure to get worse before it relents, and soon comes the time to give your two cents.

[b]As Champion of Stars Reach, strong-bodied and good health, do you have what it takes to determine who is best elf?[/b]
[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485931/a604f6c6d570d36b17ba3bdb8de61c89dfce92dd.jpg[/img]

[i]Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf is a stand-alone visual novel featuring 🔞 content. The timeline takes place according to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630550/Faulty_Apprentice__Fantasy_Dating_Sim/]true good ending of Faulty Apprentice[/url]. However, players will not need to have played the original game or DLC to enjoy this story.[/i]

💘 [b] This is a lighthearted dating sim that features hand-painted reward illustrations, Live2d animations, and high-quality voice acting.[/b] There will not be any minigames or good/evil routes like in the original Faulty Apprentice game, but the choices you make will unlock different reward scenes, so choose wisely! 

[h2]Wishlist [url=http://bit.ly/BestElf]Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf[/url] on Steam now![/h2]
